newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suspected militants kill 13 in southern Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Suspected militants kill 13 in southern Egypt.

text.p: Gunmen killed 12 people and wounded one when they opened fire on a crowded street in a town in Qena province in southern Egypt on Thursday, an Interior Ministry statement said on Friday.

Security sources also said a woman was killed and 15 were wounded when gunmen opened fire on a train as it passed through Qena on its way from Aswan to Cairo. The sources said they suspected Moslem militants of both attacks.
